title: Figma Sept 2026: each section as a card

message.text: Taken: seven section cards made under the group card "Figma: Sept 2026" (/framework/ai/2026/09/28/figma-sept-2026/). Next: Sonnet minions build each section as a live view from the site's own components, in a worktree.

Six Sonnet builders are drawing the sections now, one or two each (section 7 is split three ways because it is half the frame). Each card will show the live UI with the Figma picture under it for comparison.

First drafts of sections 1–4 draw live on their cards; I compared each with its Figma picture and sent them back: the grey section panel was missing, the spacing was too loose, and the buttons and chips looked different from the design. Sections 5–7 get the same fixes before I look at them.

Typography, Lists and the Sidebar dashboard now match their Figma pictures; UI Controls has one small fix left. The wide sections scale down like a picture, so the whole Figma layout fits the narrow card column; Forms, Pricing and the three parts of Task Management are on their second round.

All seven sections now match their Figma pictures on their cards. A fresh reviewer found the cards share some CSS class names, which would clash when several cards are open at once; one builder is fixing that now, and then I merge.
